mapper.insert: INSERT INTO revision_feedback (task_id, round_no, content, recorded_by) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{roundNo}, #{content}, #{recordedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS `id`, f.task_id AS `taskId`, f.round_no AS `roundNo`, f.content AS `content`, f.recorded_at AS `recordedAt`, u.real_name AS `recordedByName` FROM revision_feedback f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.recorded_by WHERE f.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY f.round_no
SELECT MAX(round_no) FROM revision_feedback WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
